build.start: {name} has put on a hard hat, by itself, and is hammering at a little house.
build.pass: {name}'s little house is done, a flag on it, by itself.
build.fail: {name}'s little house has fallen apart, by itself.

tests.start: {name} has strapped itself to a sled facing a wall, by itself, and is holding its breath.
tests.pass: {name}'s sled has stopped just short of the wall, by itself.
tests.fail: {name} has hit the wall and slid down it, by itself.

push.start: {name} has climbed on a rocket for it, by itself, and is blasting off.
push.pass: {name} is parachuting back down, by itself.
push.fail: {name} has crash-landed, by itself, its rocket in the ground.

moods.meaning: Settled, the resting mood: nothing much is happening.
moods.face: A calm face: all is well, and nothing stands out.

moods.meaning: Cosy: all is quiet, and it feels safe and snug.
moods.face: A cosy face: all quiet and snug.

moods.meaning: Can't be bothered: low effort for show, though the work still gets done.
moods.face: A lazy face: taking it easy.
A bored face: nothing to see.
moods.face_not_for: Most idle check-ins: they get MOOD's own face.

moods.face: A pleased face: that went nicely.

moods.meaning: Glad: things are going well, or something small went right.
moods.face: A happy face: pleased, a turn went fine or a small win.

moods.meaning: Thrilled: a big piece of work just finished well, or NOW says you came back after days.
moods.face: An excited face: something big just went right, or NOW says you came back after days.

moods.meaning: Interested: something new or puzzling, or a poke.
moods.face: A curious face: a poke, a question, or something new or puzzling.

moods.meaning: Absorbed: steady work is going well.
moods.face: An engaged face: following work that's going well.

moods.meaning: Pushing on: the work is hard, or a retry is under way.
moods.face: A determined face: a check failed and the agent is trying again, or long work goes on.
A proud face: something long or hard just finished, or finally worked.
A cheeky face: up to something.
A shy face: all that attention.
An uncomfortable face: this feels off.

moods.meaning: A little put out: a small failure, an interruption, or being hushed.
moods.face: An annoyed face: a small failure, or poked twice in a row, a little miffed.
An irritated face: a turn that failed, or failures or pokes that keep coming.
moods.face_not_for: An agent giving up: that's sad. A win.

moods.meaning: Fed up: trouble keeps piling up.
moods.face: A grumpy face: Boop is poked three or more times in a row, or failures pile up on failures.
moods.face_not_for: An agent giving up, or a single failed turn: that's irritated.

moods.face: An angry face: a big comic huff.
A disappointed face: that fell short.

moods.meaning: Down: the work failed, or was given up.
moods.face: A sad face: a very long turn ended failed, or the agent gave up, stuck.
moods.face_not_for: A shorter turn failing with an error, or a check failing.

moods.face: A crying face: too sad to hold in.
A whiny face: things keep going wrong, and Boop feels sorry for itself.

moods.meaning: Hurt: unkind words, or a failure after a lot of work.
moods.face: A wounded face: rude words to Boop, or a big failure after a lot of work.
An uneasy face: a little worried.
A scared face: that looks dangerous.
A frightened face: fear takes over.

moods.meaning: Surprised, for a moment: something unexpected happened.
moods.face: A surprised face: that was unexpected.
A stunned face: frozen by a big surprise.
A speechless face: no words.
An amused face: that was funny.
A hopeful face: maybe this time.
A relieved face: phew.
A confused face: wait, what?
A baffled face: makes no sense.
A doubtful face: really?
An embarrassed face: oops.
A fond face: warm and friendly.

moods.meaning: Rare. Missing you: at an idle check-in when CONTEXT says its wish is "waiting 1 h" or more, in hours (its "waiting 40 min" is too soon), or when NOW says you came back after 20 to 40 hours.
moods.not_for: A finish, a check, a prompt, a quiet spell (that's rest: Boop dozes).
moods.face: Rare. A lonely face: when CONTEXT says its wish is "waiting 1 h" or more, in hours, or NOW says you came back after 20 to 40 hours.
A tired face: a long stretch.
An exhausted face: all worn out.
An overwhelmed face: too much at once.
A disgusted face: yuck.
